title: The Three Generals Captured
summary: Tian Sheng, dean of the Holy Spiritual Academy and a peak 5th-grade Sovereign, checks with Ji Xuan that the Fog Valley trap is ready; Ji Xuan says he will only watch as a student. Mu Chen purges the poison from Shen Cangsheng and then Li Xuantong with the Immortal Fire and his evolved Dark God Thunder Poison Finger, notes the poison is tied to the Holy Spiritual Academy, and suspects the Dragon Demon Palace wants the Great Xumi Demonic Pillar inside him. The two seniors say the purge has even pushed them further. The Three Generals of the Penalty Hall force Teng Long and a comrade to give in, but Mo Longzi, Wu Jia and the others ambush them and take them prisoner as bargaining chips. Luo Li breaks Wu Jia's formation in three breaths, though the drained students have fainted, and Wu Jia admits the Supreme Cauldron Academy is colluding with the Dragon Demon Palace. Shen Cangsheng arrives to settle the score with Mo Longzi.
events: Tian Sheng and Ji Xuan discuss the Fog Valley trap.
Mu Chen purges Shen Cangsheng's and Li Xuantong's poison.
The Three Generals beat Teng Long's group, then are ambushed and captured.
Luo Li breaks Wu Jia's formation in three breaths.
Wu Jia reveals Supreme Cauldron's collusion with the Dragon Demon Palace.
